import 'dart:async';

import '../acquisition/atlas_evidence_accumulator.dart';
import '../models/scan_code.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_object_track.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_object_tracker.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_scan_observation.dart';
import 'atlas_continuous_candidate_projector.dart';
import 'atlas_frame_triage_gate.dart';
import 'models/atlas_continuous_candidate.dart';
import 'models/atlas_frame_quality_assessment.dart';
import 'models/atlas_perception_frame_result.dart';

typedef AtlasStableCandidateSubmitter =
    bool Function({required String trackId, required ScanCode stableCode});

final class AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig {
  const AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig({
    this.minimumFrameInterval = const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
  });

  /// Default 250 ms cadence targets approximately 4 FPS, inside the 3-5 FPS
  /// continuous-perception budget. Callers may tune this without changing the
  /// tracking or evidence contracts.
  final Duration minimumFrameInterval;
}

/// Shared 6A foundation for camera Shelf Scan and future live-feed ingestion.
///
/// Responsibilities:
/// - sample cadence enforcement
/// - frame-quality fast-fail
/// - reuse AtlasObjectTracker for spatial persistence
/// - reuse AtlasEvidenceAccumulator for stable barcode agreement
/// - emit transient candidate/result models for HUD consumers
/// - optionally cross the existing Scanner 4 submission boundary
///
/// This coordinator never mutates the Vault and never rewrites product identity.
final class AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator {
  AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator({
    AtlasObjectTracker? objectTracker,
    AtlasEvidenceAccumulator? evidenceAccumulator,
    AtlasFrameTriageGate? frameTriageGate,
    this.submitStableCandidate,
    this.config = const AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig(),
  }) : objectTracker = objectTracker ?? AtlasObjectTracker(),
       evidenceAccumulator = evidenceAccumulator ?? AtlasEvidenceAccumulator(),
       frameTriageGate = frameTriageGate ?? AtlasFrameTriageGate() {
    if (config.minimumFrameInterval.isNegative) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        config.minimumFrameInterval,
        'minimumFrameInterval',
        'minimumFrameInterval cannot be negative.',
      );
    }
  }

  final AtlasObjectTracker objectTracker;
  final AtlasEvidenceAccumulator evidenceAccumulator;
  final AtlasFrameTriageGate frameTriageGate;
  final AtlasStableCandidateSubmitter? submitStableCandidate;
  final AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig config;

  final StreamController<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult> _resultsController =
      StreamController<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult>.broadcast(sync: true);

  final Set<String> _knownTrackIds = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _submittedTrackIds = <String>{};

  DateTime? _lastInputAt;
  DateTime? _lastProcessedAt;
  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult? _latestResult;
  bool _isDisposed = false;

  Stream<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult> get results => _resultsController.stream;

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult? get latestResult => _latestResult;

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult processFrame({
    required DateTime timestamp,
    required List<AtlasScanObservation> observations,
    AtlasFrameQualitySample? qualitySample,
  }) {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      throw StateError('AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator is disposed.');
    }

    final DateTime normalizedTimestamp = timestamp.toUtc();
    final DateTime? previousInput = _lastInputAt;
    if (previousInput != null && normalizedTimestamp.isBefore(previousInput)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        timestamp,
        'timestamp',
        'Frame timestamps must be monotonic.',
      );
    }
    _lastInputAt = normalizedTimestamp;

    final AtlasFrameQualityAssessment qualityAssessment = frameTriageGate
        .evaluate(qualitySample ?? AtlasFrameQualitySample());

    final DateTime? previousProcessed = _lastProcessedAt;
    if (previousProcessed != null &&
        normalizedTimestamp.difference(previousProcessed) <
            config.minimumFrameInterval) {
      return _emit(
        AtlasPerceptionFrameResult(
          timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
          disposition: AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.skippedCadence,
          qualityAssessment: qualityAssessment,
          candidates: _projectCurrentCandidates(),
        ),
      );
    }

    _lastProcessedAt = normalizedTimestamp;

    final List<AtlasObjectTrack> tracked = objectTracker.processFrame(
      observations: qualityAssessment.isAccepted
          ? observations
          : const <AtlasScanObservation>[],
      timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
    );

    final Set<String> currentTrackIds = tracked
        .map((AtlasObjectTrack track) => track.trackId)
        .toSet();
    final Set<String> expiredTrackIds = _knownTrackIds.difference(
      currentTrackIds,
    );
    _knownTrackIds
      ..clear()
      ..addAll(currentTrackIds);

    final Set<String> submittedThisFrame = <String>{};

    if (qualityAssessment.isAccepted && submitStableCandidate != null) {
      for (final AtlasObjectTrack track in tracked) {
        if (track.isCooldown || _submittedTrackIds.contains(track.trackId)) {
          continue;
        }

        final AtlasAccumulatedEvidence? evidence = evidenceAccumulator
            .evaluateTrack(track);
        if (evidence == null || !evidence.isReadyForResolution) {
          continue;
        }

        final bool accepted = submitStableCandidate!(
          trackId: track.trackId,
          stableCode: evidence.stableCode,
        );

        if (accepted) {
          _submittedTrackIds.add(track.trackId);
          submittedThisFrame.add(track.trackId);
          objectTracker.markCooldown(
            trackId: track.trackId,
            startedAt: normalizedTimestamp,
          );
        }
      }
    }

    final AtlasPerceptionFrameResult result = AtlasPerceptionFrameResult(
      timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
      disposition: qualityAssessment.isAccepted
          ? AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.processed
          : AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.rejectedQuality,
      qualityAssessment: qualityAssessment,
      candidates: _projectCurrentCandidates(),
      expiredTrackIds: expiredTrackIds,
      submittedTrackIds: submittedThisFrame,
    );

    return _emit(result);
  }

  void reset() {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    objectTracker.reset();
    _knownTrackIds.clear();
    _submittedTrackIds.clear();
    _lastInputAt = null;
    _lastProcessedAt = null;
    _latestResult = null;
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    _isDisposed = true;
    await _resultsController.close();
  }

  List<AtlasContinuousCandidate> _projectCurrentCandidates() {
    return objectTracker.tracks
        .map((AtlasObjectTrack track) {
          final AtlasAccumulatedEvidence? evidence = evidenceAccumulator
              .evaluateTrack(track);
          return AtlasContinuousCandidateProjector.project(
            track: track,
            accumulatedEvidence: evidence,
          );
        })
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult _emit(AtlasPerceptionFrameResult result) {
    _latestResult = result;
    _resultsController.add(result);
    return result;
  }
}

import 'atlas_continuous_candidate.dart';
import 'atlas_frame_quality_assessment.dart';

enum AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition {
  processed,
  rejectedQuality,
  skippedCadence,
}

/// Immutable result emitted for one sampled perception frame.
///
/// Expired tracks are represented as IDs because spatial staleness remains
/// authoritative in AtlasObjectTracker; this model does not create a second
/// competing stale-track lifecycle.
final class AtlasPerceptionFrameResult {
  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult({
    required this.timestamp,
    required this.disposition,
    required this.qualityAssessment,
    List<AtlasContinuousCandidate> candidates =
        const <AtlasContinuousCandidate>[],
    Set<String> expiredTrackIds = const <String>{},
    Set<String> submittedTrackIds = const <String>{},
  }) : candidates = List<AtlasContinuousCandidate>.unmodifiable(candidates),
       expiredTrackIds = Set<String>.unmodifiable(expiredTrackIds),
       submittedTrackIds = Set<String>.unmodifiable(submittedTrackIds);

  final DateTime timestamp;
  final AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition disposition;
  final AtlasFrameQualityAssessment qualityAssessment;
  final List<AtlasContinuousCandidate> candidates;
  final Set<String> expiredTrackIds;
  final Set<String> submittedTrackIds;

  bool get wasProcessed =>
      disposition == AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.processed;

  bool get wasQualityRejected =>
      disposition == AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.rejectedQuality;

  bool get wasCadenceSkipped =>
      disposition == AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.skippedCadence;
}

enum AtlasFrameQualityIssue { blur, glare, motion, missingMetrics }

enum AtlasFrameQualityDecision { accepted, rejected }

/// Plugin-neutral frame-quality metrics normalized to the range 0.0-1.0.
///
/// Pixel algorithms are intentionally outside this model. Camera, screen-capture,
/// or native adapters may compute these metrics using the cheapest available
/// implementation and pass them into the shared Atlas triage gate.
final class AtlasFrameQualitySample {
  AtlasFrameQualitySample({
    this.sharpnessScore,
    this.glareRatio,
    this.motionScore,
  }) {
    _validateUnitScore(sharpnessScore, 'sharpnessScore');
    _validateUnitScore(glareRatio, 'glareRatio');
    _validateUnitScore(motionScore, 'motionScore');
  }

  final double? sharpnessScore;

  /// Approximate fraction of the frame affected by clipped/highlight glare.
  final double? glareRatio;

  /// Normalized motion magnitude where 0.0 is stable and 1.0 is extreme motion.
  final double? motionScore;

  int get availableMetricCount => <double?>[
    sharpnessScore,
    glareRatio,
    motionScore,
  ].whereType<double>().length;

  bool get hasAnyMetric => availableMetricCount > 0;

  bool get hasAllMetrics => availableMetricCount == 3;

  static void _validateUnitScore(double? value, String fieldName) {
    if (value == null) return;
    if (!value.isFinite || value < 0.0 || value > 1.0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        fieldName,
        '$fieldName must be between 0.0 and 1.0.',
      );
    }
  }
}

final class AtlasFrameQualityAssessment {
  const AtlasFrameQualityAssessment({
    required this.decision,
    required this.issues,
    required this.availableMetricCount,
  });

  final AtlasFrameQualityDecision decision;
  final Set<AtlasFrameQualityIssue> issues;
  final int availableMetricCount;

  bool get isAccepted => decision == AtlasFrameQualityDecision.accepted;

  bool get isRejected => decision == AtlasFrameQualityDecision.rejected;

  bool get hasQualityMetrics => availableMetricCount > 0;

  bool get hasCompleteQualityMetrics => availableMetricCount == 3;
}

import 'models/atlas_frame_quality_assessment.dart';

final class AtlasFrameTriageConfig {
  const AtlasFrameTriageConfig({
    this.minimumSharpnessScore = 0.35,
    this.maximumGlareRatio = 0.30,
    this.maximumMotionScore = 0.55,
    this.requireAtLeastOneMetric = false,
  });

  final double minimumSharpnessScore;
  final double maximumGlareRatio;
  final double maximumMotionScore;
  final bool requireAtLeastOneMetric;
}

/// Fast-fail quality gate that runs before OCR or expensive identity work.
///
/// The gate consumes normalized metrics instead of raw pixels so the shared
/// scan domain remains independent from camera, MediaProjection, and image
/// processing plugins.
final class AtlasFrameTriageGate {
  AtlasFrameTriageGate({this.config = const AtlasFrameTriageConfig()}) {
    _validateConfig(config);
  }

  final AtlasFrameTriageConfig config;

  AtlasFrameQualityAssessment evaluate(AtlasFrameQualitySample sample) {
    final Set<AtlasFrameQualityIssue> issues = <AtlasFrameQualityIssue>{};

    if (!sample.hasAnyMetric && config.requireAtLeastOneMetric) {
      issues.add(AtlasFrameQualityIssue.missingMetrics);
    }

    final double? sharpness = sample.sharpnessScore;
    if (sharpness != null && sharpness < config.minimumSharpnessScore) {
      issues.add(AtlasFrameQualityIssue.blur);
    }

    final double? glare = sample.glareRatio;
    if (glare != null && glare > config.maximumGlareRatio) {
      issues.add(AtlasFrameQualityIssue.glare);
    }

    final double? motion = sample.motionScore;
    if (motion != null && motion > config.maximumMotionScore) {
      issues.add(AtlasFrameQualityIssue.motion);
    }

    return AtlasFrameQualityAssessment(
      decision: issues.isEmpty
          ? AtlasFrameQualityDecision.accepted
          : AtlasFrameQualityDecision.rejected,
      issues: Set<AtlasFrameQualityIssue>.unmodifiable(issues),
      availableMetricCount: sample.availableMetricCount,
    );
  }

  static void _validateConfig(AtlasFrameTriageConfig config) {
    _validateUnitScore(config.minimumSharpnessScore, 'minimumSharpnessScore');
    _validateUnitScore(config.maximumGlareRatio, 'maximumGlareRatio');
    _validateUnitScore(config.maximumMotionScore, 'maximumMotionScore');
  }

  static void _validateUnitScore(double value, String fieldName) {
    if (!value.isFinite || value < 0.0 || value > 1.0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        fieldName,
        '$fieldName must be between 0.0 and 1.0.',
      );
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../../catalog/models/atlas_catalog_product.dart';
import '../../catalog/services/atlas_barcode_catalog_resolver.dart';
import '../engine/barcode_intelligence_engine.dart';
import '../engine/engine_context.dart';
import '../ledger/atlas_scan_ledger.dart';
import '../ledger/atlas_scan_ledger_entry.dart';
import '../models/scan_code.dart';
import '../models/scan_session.dart';
import '../models/scanner_type.dart';
import '../pipeline/standard_scan_pipeline.dart';
import '../queue/atlas_resolution_job.dart';
import '../queue/atlas_resolution_queue.dart';
import '../results/atlas_continuous_scan_result.dart';
import '../workflow/scan_intent.dart';
import '../workflow/scan_performance_mode.dart';

typedef AtlasContinuousScanChanged = void Function();

class AtlasContinuousScanSnapshot {
  const AtlasContinuousScanSnapshot({
    required this.activeResolutionCount,
    required this.pendingResolutionCount,
    required this.observedCount,
    required this.queuedCount,
    required this.resolvingCount,
    required this.resolvedCount,
    required this.reviewCount,
    required this.failedCount,
    required this.committedCount,
  });

  final int activeResolutionCount;
  final int pendingResolutionCount;
  final int observedCount;
  final int queuedCount;
  final int resolvingCount;
  final int resolvedCount;
  final int reviewCount;
  final int failedCount;
  final int committedCount;

  int get completedCount => resolvedCount + reviewCount + committedCount;

  bool get hasWorkInFlight =>
      activeResolutionCount > 0 || pendingResolutionCount > 0;
}

/// Coordinates stable physical tracks with Atlas's existing resolution stack.
///
/// This class owns queueing and ledger state, but it does not mutate the Vault.
/// A resolved item remains separate from an explicitly committed item.
class AtlasContinuousScanCoordinator {
  AtlasContinuousScanCoordinator({
    AtlasResolutionQueue? resolutionQueue,
    AtlasScanLedger? ledger,
    AtlasBarcodeCatalogResolver? catalogResolver,
    this.onChanged,
  }) : resolutionQueue =
           resolutionQueue ?? AtlasResolutionQueue(maxConcurrentJobs: 4),
       ledger = ledger ?? AtlasScanLedger(),
       _catalogResolver = catalogResolver ?? AtlasBarcodeCatalogResolver();

  final AtlasResolutionQueue resolutionQueue;
  final AtlasScanLedger ledger;
  final AtlasBarcodeCatalogResolver _catalogResolver;
  final AtlasContinuousScanChanged? onChanged;

  final Map<String, AtlasContinuousScanResult> _resultsByTrack =
      <String, AtlasContinuousScanResult>{};

  bool _isDisposed = false;

  List<AtlasContinuousScanResult> get results {
    return List<AtlasContinuousScanResult>.unmodifiable(_resultsByTrack.values);
  }

  AtlasContinuousScanResult? resultForTrack(String trackId) {
    return _resultsByTrack[trackId.trim()];
  }

  AtlasContinuousScanSnapshot get snapshot {
    final AtlasResolutionQueueSnapshot queueSnapshot = resolutionQueue.snapshot;

    int observed = 0;
    int queued = 0;
    int resolving = 0;
    int resolved = 0;
    int review = 0;
    int failed = 0;
    int committed = 0;

    for (final AtlasScanLedgerEntry entry in ledger.entries) {
      switch (entry.status) {
        case AtlasScanLedgerStatus.observed:
          observed++;
        case AtlasScanLedgerStatus.queued:
          queued++;
        case AtlasScanLedgerStatus.resolving:
          resolving++;
        case AtlasScanLedgerStatus.resolved:
          resolved++;
        case AtlasScanLedgerStatus.needsReview:
          review++;
        case AtlasScanLedgerStatus.failed:
          failed++;
        case AtlasScanLedgerStatus.committed:
          committed++;
      }
    }

    return AtlasContinuousScanSnapshot(
      activeResolutionCount: queueSnapshot.activeCount,
      pendingResolutionCount: queueSnapshot.pendingCount,
      observedCount: observed,
      queuedCount: queued,
      resolvingCount: resolving,
      resolvedCount: resolved,
      reviewCount: review,
      failedCount: failed,
      committedCount: committed,
    );
  }

  /// Submits stable evidence from one physical track.
  ///
  /// Returns true only when a new background resolution job was accepted.
  bool submit({required String trackId, required ScanCode stableCode}) {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      return false;
    }

    final String normalizedTrackId = trackId.trim();

    if (normalizedTrackId.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(trackId, 'trackId', 'trackId cannot be empty.');
    }

    final DateTime now = DateTime.now().toUtc();
    final AtlasScanLedgerEntry? existing = ledger.entryForTrack(
      normalizedTrackId,
    );

    if (existing != null) {
      return false;
    }

    ledger.observe(trackId: normalizedTrackId, stableCode: stableCode, at: now);

    ledger.markQueued(trackId: normalizedTrackId, at: now);

    _notifyChanged();

    _enqueueResolution(
      trackId: normalizedTrackId,
      stableCode: stableCode,
      createdAt: now,
    );

    return true;
  }

  /// Explicitly retries a failed physical track.
  ///
  /// Retry never creates a second ledger entry and never auto-commits. The
  /// original stable barcode evidence is reused for a new resolution attempt.
  bool retryFailedTrack({required String trackId}) {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      return false;
    }

    final String normalizedTrackId = trackId.trim();

    if (normalizedTrackId.isEmpty ||
        resolutionQueue.containsTrack(normalizedTrackId)) {
      return false;
    }

    final AtlasScanLedgerEntry? entry = ledger.entryForTrack(normalizedTrackId);

    if (entry == null || !entry.hasFailed) {
      return false;
    }

    final DateTime now = DateTime.now().toUtc();

    ledger.markQueued(trackId: normalizedTrackId, at: now, allowRetry: true);

    _resultsByTrack.remove(normalizedTrackId);

    _notifyChanged();

    _enqueueResolution(
      trackId: normalizedTrackId,
      stableCode: entry.stableCode,
      createdAt: now,
    );

    return true;
  }

  bool markCommitted({required String trackId, DateTime? at}) {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      return false;
    }

    final AtlasScanLedgerEntry? entry = ledger.entryForTrack(trackId);

    if (entry == null) {
      return false;
    }

    if (entry.isCommitted) {
      return true;
    }

    if (!entry.isResolved && !entry.needsReview) {
      return false;
    }

    ledger.markCommitted(trackId: trackId, at: at ?? DateTime.now().toUtc());

    _notifyChanged();
    return true;
  }

  bool applyInspection({
    required String trackId,
    required ScanSession session,
  }) {
    if (_isDisposed) return false;
    final normalizedTrackId = trackId.trim();
    final existing = _resultsByTrack[normalizedTrackId];
    if (existing == null || existing.session.sessionId != session.sessionId) {
      return false;
    }
    final assessment = session.authenticityContribution?.assessment;
    if (assessment == null) return false;
    _resultsByTrack[normalizedTrackId] = existing.copyWith(session: session);
    ledger.applyInspectionReview(
      trackId: normalizedTrackId,
      requiresReview:
          assessment.requiresReview ||
          session.requiresUserAction ||
          !existing.catalogResolution.hasSingleMatch,
      at: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
    );
    _notifyChanged();
    return true;
  }

  bool get canResetCompletedSession {
    final List<AtlasScanLedgerEntry> entries = ledger.entries;

    return !_isDisposed &&
        resolutionQueue.snapshot.isIdle &&
        entries.isNotEmpty &&
        entries.every((AtlasScanLedgerEntry entry) => entry.isCommitted);
  }

  bool resetCompletedSession() {
    if (!canResetCompletedSession) {
      return false;
    }

    ledger.clear();
    _resultsByTrack.clear();
    _notifyChanged();
    return true;
  }

  void dispose() {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      return;
    }

    _isDisposed = true;
    resolutionQueue.dispose();
  }

  void _enqueueResolution({
    required String trackId,
    required ScanCode stableCode,
    required DateTime createdAt,
  }) {
    final String jobId = _createJobId(trackId: trackId, createdAt: createdAt);

    unawaited(
      resolutionQueue
          .enqueue(
            AtlasResolutionJob(
              jobId: jobId,
              trackId: trackId,
              createdAt: createdAt,
              execute: () =>
                  _resolveTrack(trackId: trackId, stableCode: stableCode),
            ),
          )
          .catchError((Object error, StackTrace stackTrace) {
            _handleQueueFailure(trackId: trackId, error: error);
          }),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _resolveTrack({
    required String trackId,
    required ScanCode stableCode,
  }) async {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      return;
    }

    final DateTime startedAt = DateTime.now().toUtc();

    ledger.markResolving(trackId: trackId, at: startedAt);
    _notifyChanged();

    try {
      final String executionId = _createExecutionId(
        startedAt,
        stableCode.normalizedValue,
      );

      final EngineContext engineContext = EngineContext(
        requestId: executionId,
        createdAt: startedAt,
        connectivity: EngineConnectivity.unknown,
        deviceType: EngineDeviceType.mobile,
        deviceCapabilities: const <String>{
          BarcodeIntelligenceEngine.capabilityId,
        },
        attributes: <String, Object?>{
          'scanSource': ScanCodeSource.camera.name,
          'scannerType': ScannerType.mobileScanner.name,
          'barcodeFormat': stableCode.format.name,
          'trackId': trackId,
          'continuousScan': true,
        },
      );

      final ScanSession initialSession = ScanSession(
        sessionId: executionId,
        startedAt: startedAt,
        status: ScanSessionStatus.analyzing,
        intent: ScanIntent.identifyProduct,
        performanceMode: ScanPerformanceMode.fastBarcodeOnly,
        scannerType: ScannerType.mobileScanner,
        detectedCodes: <ScanCode>[stableCode],
        bestCandidate: stableCode,
      );

      final pipeline = StandardScanPipeline.create(engineContext);
      final result = await pipeline.process(initialSession, engineContext);

      final ScanSession finalSession = result.finalSession;

      final ScanCode? resolvedCode =
          finalSession.bestCandidate ?? _firstDetectedCode(finalSession);

      final AtlasBarcodeResolution catalogResolution;

      if (resolvedCode == null ||
          !resolvedCode.isValid ||
          !resolvedCode.isProductBarcode) {
        catalogResolution = AtlasBarcodeResolution.invalid(
          barcode: resolvedCode?.normalizedValue ?? '',
        );
      } else if (finalSession.catalogProduct != null) {
        catalogResolution = AtlasBarcodeResolution.matches(
          barcode: resolvedCode.normalizedValue,
          matches: <AtlasCatalogProduct>[finalSession.catalogProduct!],
        );
      } else {
        catalogResolution = await _catalogResolver.resolve(
          resolvedCode.normalizedValue,
        );
      }

      final DateTime completedAt = DateTime.now().toUtc();

      final AtlasContinuousScanResult continuousResult =
          AtlasContinuousScanResult(
            trackId: trackId,
            session: finalSession,
            catalogResolution: catalogResolution,
            completedAt: completedAt,
          );

      _resultsByTrack[trackId] = continuousResult;

      if (continuousResult.requiresUserReview) {
        ledger.markNeedsReview(
          trackId: trackId,
          resolutionSessionId: finalSession.sessionId,
          at: completedAt,
        );
      } else {
        ledger.markResolved(
          trackId: trackId,
          resolutionSessionId: finalSession.sessionId,
          at: completedAt,
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      ledger.markFailed(
        trackId: trackId,
        error: error,
        at: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
      );
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      _notifyChanged();
    }
  }

  void _handleQueueFailure({required String trackId, required Object error}) {
    final AtlasScanLedgerEntry? entry = ledger.entryForTrack(trackId);

    if (entry == null || entry.hasFailed) {
      _notifyChanged();
      return;
    }

    if (entry.isQueued) {
      ledger.markResolving(trackId: trackId, at: DateTime.now().toUtc());
    }

    final AtlasScanLedgerEntry? current = ledger.entryForTrack(trackId);

    if (current != null && current.isResolving) {
      ledger.markFailed(
        trackId: trackId,
        error: error,
        at: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
      );
    }

    _notifyChanged();
  }

  ScanCode? _firstDetectedCode(ScanSession session) {
    if (session.detectedCodes.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }

    return session.detectedCodes.first;
  }

  String _createExecutionId(DateTime createdAt, String code) {
    final int codeHash = code.hashCode.abs();

    return 'scan_'
        '${createdAt.microsecondsSinceEpoch}_'
        '$codeHash';
  }

  String _createJobId({required String trackId, required DateTime createdAt}) {
    return 'resolution_'
        '${createdAt.microsecondsSinceEpoch}_'
        '${trackId.hashCode.abs()}';
  }

  void _notifyChanged() {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      return;
    }

    onChanged?.call();
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';

import 'package:mobile_scanner/mobile_scanner.dart';

import '../models/scan_code.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_scan_observation.dart';

/// Adapts mobile_scanner capture data into Atlas acquisition observations.
///
/// This is intentionally the plugin boundary. The tracking domain remains
/// independent from Flutter camera/plugin geometry.
abstract final class AtlasMobileScannerObservationAdapter {
  static List<AtlasScanObservation> fromCapture(
    BarcodeCapture capture, {
    required DateTime capturedAt,
  }) {
    final List<AtlasScanObservation> observations = <AtlasScanObservation>[];

    final Size captureSize = capture.size;
    final bool hasUsableCaptureSize =
        captureSize.width.isFinite &&
        captureSize.height.isFinite &&
        captureSize.width > 0.0 &&
        captureSize.height > 0.0;

    int observationSequence = 0;

    for (final Barcode barcode in capture.barcodes) {
      final String rawValue = barcode.rawValue?.trim() ?? '';

      if (rawValue.isEmpty) {
        continue;
      }

      final ScanCodeFormat format = _mapBarcodeFormat(barcode.format);

      final ScanCode scanCode = ScanCode(
        rawValue: rawValue,
        normalizedValue: _normalizeCodeValue(rawValue),
        format: format,
        source: ScanCodeSource.camera,
        capturedAt: capturedAt,
        isValid: format != ScanCodeFormat.unknown,
        confidence: 1.0,
      );

      final List<AtlasNormalizedPoint> normalizedCorners = hasUsableCaptureSize
          ? _normalizeCorners(barcode.corners, captureSize)
          : const <AtlasNormalizedPoint>[];

      observations.add(
        AtlasScanObservation(
          observationId: _createObservationId(
            capturedAt: capturedAt,
            sequence: observationSequence,
            code: scanCode,
          ),
          capturedAt: capturedAt,
          code: scanCode,
          cornerPoints: normalizedCorners,
          confidence: scanCode.confidence,
        ),
      );

      observationSequence++;
    }

    return List<AtlasScanObservation>.unmodifiable(observations);
  }

  static List<AtlasNormalizedPoint> _normalizeCorners(
    List<Offset> corners,
    Size captureSize,
  ) {
    if (corners.isEmpty) {
      return const <AtlasNormalizedPoint>[];
    }

    final List<AtlasNormalizedPoint> normalized = <AtlasNormalizedPoint>[];

    for (final Offset corner in corners) {
      if (!corner.dx.isFinite || !corner.dy.isFinite) {
        continue;
      }

      normalized.add(
        AtlasNormalizedPoint(
          x: _normalizeCoordinate(corner.dx, captureSize.width),
          y: _normalizeCoordinate(corner.dy, captureSize.height),
        ),
      );
    }

    return List<AtlasNormalizedPoint>.unmodifiable(normalized);
  }

  static double _normalizeCoordinate(double value, double extent) {
    if (!value.isFinite || !extent.isFinite || extent <= 0.0) {
      return 0.0;
    }

    return (value / extent).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  static ScanCodeFormat _mapBarcodeFormat(BarcodeFormat format) {
    return switch (format) {
      BarcodeFormat.upcA => ScanCodeFormat.upcA,
      BarcodeFormat.upcE => ScanCodeFormat.upcE,
      BarcodeFormat.ean8 => ScanCodeFormat.ean8,
      BarcodeFormat.ean13 => ScanCodeFormat.ean13,
      BarcodeFormat.qrCode => ScanCodeFormat.qrCode,
      _ => ScanCodeFormat.unknown,
    };
  }

  static String _normalizeCodeValue(String rawValue) {
    return rawValue.trim();
  }

  static String _createObservationId({
    required DateTime capturedAt,
    required int sequence,
    required ScanCode code,
  }) {
    final int codeHash = code.normalizedValue.hashCode.abs();

    return 'obs_'
        '${capturedAt.microsecondsSinceEpoch}_'
        '${sequence}_'
        '$codeHash';
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:mobile_scanner/mobile_scanner.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import 'package:funkovault2/services/app_state.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/scan/acquisition/atlas_continuous_scan_coordinator.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/scan/acquisition/atlas_evidence_accumulator.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/scan/acquisition/atlas_mobile_scanner_observation_adapter.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/scan/tracking/atlas_object_track.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/scan/tracking/atlas_object_tracker.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/scan/tracking/atlas_scan_observation.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/screens/catalog/funko_catalog_screen.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/screens/scanner/atlas_haul_review_screen.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/widgets/scanner/atlas_haul_session_panel.dart';

class ScanScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ScanScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ScanScreen> createState() {
    return _ScanScreenState();
  }
}

class _ScanScreenState extends State<ScanScreen> {
  final MobileScannerController _scannerController = MobileScannerController(
    formats: const <BarcodeFormat>[
      BarcodeFormat.upcA,
      BarcodeFormat.upcE,
      BarcodeFormat.ean8,
      BarcodeFormat.ean13,
      BarcodeFormat.qrCode,
    ],
  );

  final AtlasObjectTracker _objectTracker = AtlasObjectTracker();

  final AtlasEvidenceAccumulator _evidenceAccumulator =
      AtlasEvidenceAccumulator();

  late final AtlasContinuousScanCoordinator _coordinator;

  int _activeTrackCount = 0;
  int _confirmedTrackCount = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    _coordinator = AtlasContinuousScanCoordinator(
      onChanged: _handleCoordinatorChanged,
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _coordinator.dispose();
    _scannerController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _handleCoordinatorChanged() {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    setState(() {});
  }

  void _handleDetection(BarcodeCapture capture) {
    final DateTime capturedAt = DateTime.now().toUtc();

    final List<AtlasScanObservation> observations =
        AtlasMobileScannerObservationAdapter.fromCapture(
          capture,
          capturedAt: capturedAt,
        );

    if (observations.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    final List<AtlasScanObservation> trackableObservations = observations
        .where((AtlasScanObservation observation) => observation.hasGeometry)
        .toList(growable: false);

    if (trackableObservations.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    final List<AtlasObjectTrack> tracks = _objectTracker.processFrame(
      observations: trackableObservations,
      timestamp: capturedAt,
    );

    _updateTrackingStatus(tracks);

    for (final AtlasObjectTrack track in tracks) {
      final AtlasAccumulatedEvidence? evidence = _evidenceAccumulator
          .evaluateTrack(track);

      if (evidence == null || !evidence.isReadyForResolution) {
        continue;
      }

      final bool accepted = _coordinator.submit(
        trackId: track.trackId,
        stableCode: evidence.stableCode,
      );

      if (accepted) {
        _objectTracker.markCooldown(
          trackId: track.trackId,
          startedAt: capturedAt,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  void _updateTrackingStatus(List<AtlasObjectTrack> tracks) {
    final int confirmedCount = tracks
        .where((AtlasObjectTrack track) => track.isConfirmed)
        .length;

    if (!mounted ||
        (_activeTrackCount == tracks.length &&
            _confirmedTrackCount == confirmedCount)) {
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _activeTrackCount = tracks.length;
      _confirmedTrackCount = confirmedCount;
    });
  }

  void _startNewHaul() {
    final bool reset = _coordinator.resetCompletedSession();

    if (!reset || !mounted) {
      return;
    }

    _objectTracker.reset();

    setState(() {
      _activeTrackCount = 0;
      _confirmedTrackCount = 0;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _openHaulReview() async {
    final String collectionName = context.read<AppState>().selectedCollection;

    await _scannerController.stop();

    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) {
          return AtlasHaulReviewScreen(
            coordinator: _coordinator,
            collectionName: collectionName,
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    if (mounted) {
      await _scannerController.start();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openCatalog() async {
    await _scannerController.stop();

    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) {
          return const FunkoCatalogScreen();
        },
      ),
    );

    if (mounted) {
      await _scannerController.start();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final AtlasContinuousScanSnapshot coordinatorSnapshot =
        _coordinator.snapshot;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Scan Pop')),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          SizedBox(
            height: 260,
            child: Stack(
              fit: StackFit.expand,
              children: [
                MobileScanner(
                  controller: _scannerController,
                  onDetect: _handleDetection,
                ),
                const _ScannerGuide(),
                Positioned(
                  top: 16,
                  left: 16,
                  right: 16,
                  child: _TrackingStatusOverlay(
                    activeTrackCount: _activeTrackCount,
                    confirmedTrackCount: _confirmedTrackCount,
                    snapshot: coordinatorSnapshot,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: SafeArea(
              top: false,
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                children: [
                  AtlasHaulSessionPanel(
                    entries: _coordinator.ledger.entries,
                    results: _coordinator.results,
                    activeResolutionCount:
                        coordinatorSnapshot.activeResolutionCount,
                    pendingResolutionCount:
                        coordinatorSnapshot.pendingResolutionCount,
                    onReviewHaul: _coordinator.ledger.entries.isEmpty
                        ? null
                        : _openHaulReview,
                    onStartNewHaul: _coordinator.canResetCompletedSession
                        ? _startNewHaul
                        : null,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _openCatalog,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.search),
                      label: const Text('Browse Catalog'),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ScannerGuide extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ScannerGuide();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return IgnorePointer(
      child: Center(
        child: Container(
          width: 280,
          height: 170,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 3),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _TrackingStatusOverlay extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TrackingStatusOverlay({
    required this.activeTrackCount,
    required this.confirmedTrackCount,
    required this.snapshot,
  });

  final int activeTrackCount;
  final int confirmedTrackCount;
  final AtlasContinuousScanSnapshot snapshot;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final String label;

    if (snapshot.hasWorkInFlight) {
      label =
          'ðŸ§  ${snapshot.activeResolutionCount} resolving â€¢ '
          '${snapshot.pendingResolutionCount} queued';
    } else if (snapshot.completedCount > 0) {
      label =
          'âœ… ${snapshot.completedCount} resolved â€¢ '
          '$activeTrackCount tracked';
    } else if (confirmedTrackCount > 0) {
      label =
          'ðŸŽ¯ $confirmedTrackCount confirmed â€¢ '
          '$activeTrackCount tracked';
    } else if (activeTrackCount > 0) {
      label = 'ðŸ‘€ $activeTrackCount tracked â€¢ stabilizing';
    } else {
      label = 'ðŸ“· Continuous tracking active';
    }

    return IgnorePointer(
      child: Center(
        child: DecoratedBox(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.black54,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          ),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
            child: Text(
              label,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

    super.key,
  });

      create: (_) => AtlasNavigationController(),
      child: const _AtlasNavigationShellView(),

class _AtlasNavigationShellView extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AtlasNavigationShellView();

  static const int _scannerIndex = 2;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final AtlasNavigationController controller =
    context.watch<AtlasNavigationController>();

    final List<Widget> pages = <Widget>[
      const AtlasHomeScreen(),
      const CollectorVaultScreen(),

      // Only create ScanScreen while the Scan tab is active.
      //
      // This prevents MobileScanner from initializing the camera when
      // Atlas first launches and disposes the scanner when the user
      // leaves the Scan tab.
      if (controller.index == _scannerIndex)
        const ScanScreen(
          key: ValueKey<String>('atlas-active-scanner'),
        )
      else
        const SizedBox.shrink(
          key: ValueKey<String>('atlas-inactive-scanner'),
        ),

      const AtlasInsightsScreen(),
      const AtlasAcademyScreen(),
      const SettingsScreen(),
    ];

    return Scaffold(
      body: IndexedStack(
        index: controller.index,
        children: pages,
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: AtlasBottomNavigation(
        currentIndex: controller.index,
        onTap: controller.goTo,
      ),
    );
  }
}
